# NexGenio LTD
> Boutique GRC and security architecture consultancy based in Malta, helping organisations across Europe navigate NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001/42001/22301, and AI governance requirements.

## Pages

- [Home](https://nexgenio.com/) — ISO & regulatory compliance programmes for essential entities, financial entities, and organisations across Europe
- [Training Hub](https://nexgenio.com/training/index.html) — All PECB-certified training courses (self-paced and live), with exam and certificate included
- [Live Courses](https://nexgenio.com/live/index.html) — Live instructor-led training schedule; next course: ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer, starts 21 September 2026
- [Blog](https://nexgenio.com/blog/index.html) — Insights and updates on compliance, cybersecurity, and AI governance

## Reference Tables

- [NIS2 to ISO 27001 mapping](https://nexgenio.com/nis2-iso-27001-mapping.html) — All 49 requirements of the Annex to Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2024/2690 mapped to ISO/IEC 27001:2022 clauses and Annex A controls, reproduced from ENISA's own mapping table version 1.1 (10 July 2025). Includes a reverse index from each of the 93 Annex A controls to the NIS2 requirements it serves, the Article 21(2) linkage for every requirement, and a list of the NIS2 obligations that have no ISO 27001 equivalent — registration with the national authority, the 24-hour/72-hour/one-month incident reporting cascade, and the Article 20 management body accountability and training duty. 69 of the 93 Annex A controls are referenced by the mapping. Free, no signup

## Regulatory Services

- [NIS2 compliance](https://nexgenio.com/nis2.html) — Scope determination for essential and important entities, the ten Article 21 risk management measures, Article 20 board accountability, incident reporting timelines and supply chain security. Covers the Dutch Cyberbeveiligingswet, in force 15 August 2026. Entry point is the fixed-scope, fixed-price NIS2 Baseline Check
- [DORA Article 16](https://nexgenio.com/dora-article-16.html) — The simplified ICT risk management framework for smaller financial entities: the six categories it covers, the four obligations that fall away, and why eligibility cannot be read off a public register. Relevant to small and non-interconnected investment firms, exempted payment and e-money institutions, small IORPs and microenterprises
- [NIS2 board training](https://nexgenio.com/nis2-board-training.html) — Management body training meeting the NIS2 Article 20(2) duty. Half-day board sessions, annual refreshers and new director onboarding, in English or German, with an evidence pack of agenda, materials and attendance record

## Live Courses

- [ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer - Live-Online](https://nexgenio.com/live/iso-27001-lead-implementer.html) — 5-day live-online course with PECB certification exam, two dates open (Sep and Oct 2026), €2,222/seat

## Self-Paced Courses

- [NIS2 Directive Lead Implementer](https://nexgenio.com/self/nis2-lead-implementer.html) — Implement and manage a cybersecurity programme aligned with the NIS2 Directive
- [NIS2 Directive Foundation](https://nexgenio.com/self/nis2-foundation.html) — Foundational understanding of NIS2 Directive requirements and principles
- [DORA Lead Manager](https://nexgenio.com/self/dora-lead-manager.html) — Lead digital operational resilience management under DORA regulation
- [DORA Foundation](https://nexgenio.com/self/dora-foundation.html) — Foundational understanding of DORA requirements for financial entities
- [ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer](https://nexgenio.com/self/iso-27001-lead-implementer.html) — Implement and manage an information security management system (ISMS)
- [ISO/IEC 42001 Lead Implementer](https://nexgenio.com/self/iso-42001-lead-implementer.html) — Implement and manage an AI management system (AIMS) per ISO 42001
- [ISO 22301 Lead Implementer](https://nexgenio.com/self/iso-22301-lead-implementer.html) — Implement and manage a business continuity management system (BCMS)
- [ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Implementer](https://nexgenio.com/self/iso-27701-lead-implementer.html) — Implement and manage a privacy information management system (PIMS)
- [ISO 31000 Risk Manager](https://nexgenio.com/self/iso-31000-risk-manager.html) — Risk management principles and guidelines per ISO 31000
- [Certified AI Manager (CAIM)](https://nexgenio.com/self/caim.html) — AI governance, ethics, and management certification
- [ISA/IEC 62443 Lead Implementer](https://nexgenio.com/self/isa-iec-62443-lead-implementer.html) — Implement and manage an industrial automation and control systems (IACS) security programme per ISA/IEC 62443
